## Recommendations

::: {.ppadem-card-grid}
::: {.ppadem-card}
### Governments
Publish party funding returns in a searchable format.
:::

::: {.ppadem-card .teal}
### Electoral bodies
Audit a random sample of returns each cycle.
:::

::: {.ppadem-card .gold}
### Parties
Adopt internal finance reporting ahead of regulation.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## About PPADEM
Political Parties and Democracy in Africa (PPADEM) is a multi-year research
project covering 80 political parties across 25 nations.
:::
